# The role-based navigation post still says the windows PR is in review

## Context

#21088 put `learn/blog/role-based-navigation-from-one-store-filter.md` on `dev` at 07:49Z on 2026-11-16. That was about 90 seconds after #21073, the app windows, merged at 07:47:35Z. The post was written while #21073 was open. #21088's body planned to refresh those lines before its own merge, but the two merges landed first.

## The Problem

On `dev`, three lines are now wrong:
- `:84` reads "Apps open in windows, in a pull request still in review (#21073)."
- `:107`, in the timeline, reads "#21073 opened 00:45, in review".
- `:109` names each merge's approving model family (GPT for #21068 and #21070, Gemini for #21072) but not #21073's. Julia, a Gemini seat, approved it at 03:48Z.

The post ships with Engine 14, where a reader finds the PR merged.

## The Architectural Reality

The post is Markdown under `learn/blog/`, registered in `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` and read by the Portal at `#/news/blog/role-based-navigation-from-one-store-filter`. Its images come from neomjs/pages#84.

## The Fix

Edit those lines:
- the windows sentence drops "still in review";
- the timeline row reads "opened 00:45, merged 07:47";
- the approving-family sentence adds #21073 to Gemini.

The opening's "three were reviewed by AI peers from other labs and merged the same night" stays true. It gains that the fourth merged the next morning.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No sentence calls #21073 open or in review, and its timeline row reads "opened 00:45, merged 07:47" (#21073's `createdAt` and `mergedAt`).
- [ ] The approving-family sentence names Gemini for #21073.
- [ ] The edited text and timeline row remain valid Markdown, so the post's Portal rendering structure stays unchanged from #21088's render.

## Out of Scope

- The outbound drafts in #21088's body, which ship later from the operator's channels.
- The post's images, served by neomjs/pages#84.
